g.text: PX4 IMU -> EKF: execution contexts and wakeups

text.tspan: Dashed orange = schedule/wake | Teal = retained uORB data | Grey = device I/O
One DRDY interrupt is not one main EKF step.
Inside EKF2, setIMUData() advances the output predictor for each ingested IMU report.
The main EKF state/covariance prediction and fusion are gated by the EKF's own IMU downsampler.
FIFO batching, VehicleIMU integration, and pending-work coalescing further separate DRDY rate from EKF update rate.
In multi-EKF mode (SENS_IMU_MODE=0), an EKF instance can consume vehicle_imu directly on its INSx queue.
